memories.content: The atlas release build repeatedly gets cancelled by CI because the pipeline has no persistent cargo registry cache: every run starts cold, which adds ~18 minutes, leaving little headroom under CI's hard 30-minute job timeout — any normal-length build then tips over and gets killed. Fix: add persistent caching for the cargo registry (and ideally target/) to the atlas release pipeline config, rather than raising the timeout.
